concepts.name: Animal Jumps
concepts.definition: Central learning focus developed by the chapter 'Animal Jumps'.
concepts.evidence: Numbers put in this box get multiplied by a number and come out.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Using chapter information to support an explanation or answer.
concepts.evidence: (a) Can you guess the multiplier if you see the 4 numbers coming out of the box?

concepts.name: Application
concepts.definition: Using the chapter idea in a new but related situation.
concepts.evidence: (b) Is there more than one possible multiplier?
